about.meta_description: NOVA is a B2B partner for businesses across Europe. We source products, design websites and manage IT, with one contact from the first quote to the delivery.
about.title: One partner for the products and the tech your business runs on.

welcome: NOVA is a B2B partner for businesses across Europe. We find the products you sell and use, and we design and look after the websites and tech you run on. You tell us what you need. We find the supplier, check the samples and manage the delivery, or design your website and keep it running.
We are a new company, started in October 2026. You deal with one person from the first quote to the delivery.

help_shipping.title: Shipping
help_shipping.lead: Where we deliver, what it costs and how long it takes.

p: We deliver to the 27 countries of the European Union and to Norway, Iceland and Liechtenstein. If your country is not in the list at checkout, write to us.
Shipping is a flat rate per order, shown in the cart before you pay. TODO: confirm amounts. Ready-made websites have no shipping.
Each product page shows how many working days we need to dispatch. Delivery then takes 3 to 7 working days. TODO: confirm.
We email you the tracking number when your order ships.
You can order up to 200 pieces of a product online. For more, request a quote and we will price the order and the shipping together.

help_returns.title: Returns
help_returns.lead: How to return a product and what to expect.

p: You can return NFC products within 14 days of delivery. They must be unused and in the original packaging. You pay the return shipping.
We start work on a website at your request, straight after payment. Once the website is delivered, the right of withdrawal ends. You confirm this with a tick box before you pay.
Consumers keep the 2-year legal guarantee for faulty goods. Business buyers have no right of withdrawal, but can claim for faulty goods.
Write to orders@novaporto.eu with your order number. We reply with the return address. Refunds go back to the payment method you used.

legal_privacy.title: Privacy
legal_privacy.lead: What data the shop uses and who processes it for us.

p: TODO: legal name and address of the company. Contact: info@novaporto.eu
When you order: your name, email, delivery and billing address, VAT number if you give one, and what you ordered. We do not see or store card details.
These companies process data for us:
list: Stripe: payment, tax calculation, invoices and fraud prevention
Supabase (EU region, Frankfurt): order and account database
Cloudflare: hosting, security and bot protection (Turnstile)

p: Necessary storage keeps your cart, your cookie choice and your session, and Stripe sets fraud-prevention cookies on its payment page. Analytics and marketing cookies are used only if you accept them in the cookie settings.
You can ask for a copy of your data or for its deletion by writing to info@novaporto.eu. Invoices and order records are kept for the period the law requires.
